newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm, rollovers pick up.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm, rollovers pick up.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures found inspiration in the Dow's overnight recovery on Tuesday and traded in positive territory throughout the session.
Nikkei 225 December futures ended 200 points higher at 20,795 on turnover of 32,000 lots. March added 195 points to 20,835 on 22,920 lots.
Dealers said the heavy volume reflected players rolling over their positions to the March contract ahead of December's expiry on Thursday.

A trader with a Japanese house said the Nikkei also received a boost from a drop in Japanese bond prices on reports that Bank of Japan governor Yasuo Matsushita said the latest tankan showed evidence of economic recovery and Japan's long-term rates had bottomed out.
"The daily charts are showing a buy signal," he said, adding that the March contract was likely to head higher to test resistance around 21,000.
"A buy-on-dips, sell-on-strength strategy is preferred," he said, adding that the March Nikkei would have trouble rising above 21,000 in the short-term.
